decision: A bound native-document text notification is a transport wake only. Retain native binding resources, use existing admission and actual document verification, and cancel on field/focus/lease/layout retirement. No GNOME, non-Chrome, delivery, reducer, verifier or ACK contract change.
reason: Physical v119-v122 callbacks can run before Chrome accessibility text is updated. Neither arbitrary delay nor stale snapshot can prove insertion. A real native notification supplies the missing wake, not authority.
acceptance: v134-r2 physical KDE Chrome: five-field5/5, normal ten-types10/10, incognito3/3, fullscreen2/3 (iframe-rich FAIL after native deadline/canonical desktop lifetime change). v135 source/build/install/physical gates pending. Full320 matrix unchanged.
transport_lifetime_review: v125: completed/cancelled subscriptions retire liveness; a later valid read can rearm. Read reuse preserves unique application validation; snapshot acceptance rechecks focused editable/nonprivate field after awaited text reads. Existing 20ms bound and canonical authority remain unchanged.
transient_observation_contract: v127: a bounded read deadline or incoherent in-flight document update invalidates every document-derived proof/revision but is not a missing input key. Preserve only the same admitted transport subscription so the existing key path may emit literal input. Fresh authenticated actual data is required before edits/readout. Identity/privacy/admission/selection loss still drops binding and revokes. No synthetic SSI, ACK, capability, timer or second owner.
literal_input_mode_contract: v130: canonical Ready may retain acquisition-owned literal preedit while clearing per-word mode. Only KDE native Chrome, a current bound actual snapshot matching the entire owned literal tail, and an unset mode may rejoin the existing ManagedCommit selector. Established modes and all common commit/admission/document/verifier guards remain unchanged. This initializes transport policy, never ACK, SSI, capabilities or edit authority.
late_known_display_contract: v131: fresh authenticated KDE Chrome actual word, unchanged canonical input frame and existing visible-input scheduler can seed a late known-word hint after literal transfer cancelled its old generation. Exact frame coalescing is display-only; no edit proof, synthetic pending/ACK/SSI/capability, deadline or authority change. Token/owner changes cannot reuse its marker. Common/GNOME paths unchanged.
initial_cursor_wake_contract: v132: an actual cursor display callback may establish a missing first native binding through the same bounded, authenticated focused-document read. A missed initial read must not suppress all later real cursor wakes. Existing privacy, field identity, admission, snapshot and edit checks remain unchanged. Physical five-field result still fails missing hints and stale geometry; not accepted.
managed_readout_contract: v133 development trial: an independently current authenticated KDE Chrome native word AND the existing exact post-CommitText managed-word receipt may witness a retained UnknownStart suffix for readout/explicit append. Keep every existing snapshot, boundary, privacy, token and scope guard. Do not alter lineage completeness/counts, canonical KnownStart frames or exact-suffix whole-word checks. Native policy stays in KDE; common code only consults its predicate at the retained-character count gate. GNOME policy and source remain unchanged.
hint_geometry_contract: v133 HidePreedit trial physically rejected: no Chrome cursor wake and invisible hints. v134 uses an optional actual last-character bound in the existing bounded native snapshot; positive validated size, checked right edge, exact snapshot/field/token/lease/layout/tail binding; transport result reuse clears it. Missing or stale native bounds suppress stale IBus fallback. Geometry is presentation only; original document/edit authority and GNOME/non-Chrome policy remain unchanged. No timer, retry, suffix composition, synthetic ACK or new transport owner. Physical acceptance pending.
geometry_review_contract: v135: geometry is excluded from the entire selection preflight. A geometry await precedes actual text/caret/selection revalidation and final field/privacy validation under the same20ms deadline. Missing native bounds allow one read on an existing real cursor callback even with current readout. No timer/retry, authority change, GNOME or non-Chrome policy change.
